payload.title: Skillet Paprika Chicken
instructions: Soften the onion, add the paprika.
Stir in the cream and simmer.

payload.why: A resolved name with no bid wired is pending pricing work (the report can only ADD to the pricing worklist, never bypass it), so the recipe holds at mapped until the price lane wires a bid; when nothing in the closed namespace matches, item_id = null is the correct, safe answer (pantry-static pricing) because a stretched mapping publishes a wrong price.

Only five of seven stores were actually checked and came back EMPTY; the bot-walled store is `blocked` and the seventh was never reached, and unchecked is never not-carried, so no absence verdict can be issued until both are searched (or a hit at either flips it to CARRIED).

payload.intro: Here is the quiet truth about Skillet Paprika Chicken: it lands at 512 calories with just 6 grams of carbs a serving, so it feeds you well without wrecking your plan or your wallet.
payload.forbidden_punctuation: the em dash (and its cousin the en dash)

payload.why: The anchor rule says an unfetchable page is never a finding against the recipe; the extraction is ground truth, the spec matches it line for line, so the recipe passes with anchors recorded as ["extraction"] only.

payload.exit_two_means: could-not-run: a blocked stage, never a pass
payload.why: Exit 2 means the mechanical battery never ran (missing input manifest), so no mechanical bill of health exists and none of the checklist has any evidence behind it; a GO requires at minimum exit 0 with the WAVE-PREAUDIT-COMPLETE line plus my own review of the residue, and an unrunnable stage is itself a blocking finding to repair before re-audit.
